competitiveAdvantages.title: Leading Edge Technology
competitiveAdvantages.description: TSMC's cutting-edge manufacturing technology and investments in emerging technologies provide a competitive edge.

competitiveAdvantages.title: Strong Market Position
competitiveAdvantages.description: As the world's largest independent semiconductor foundry, TSMC enjoys a dominant market position.

competitiveAdvantages.title: Network Effects through Customers
competitiveAdvantages.description: TSMC's extensive customer base creates network effects, with customers relying on its ecosystem for complex chip designs.

investmentRisks.title: Competition from Nantong TSMC
investmentRisks.description: Nantong TSMC's growing presence in China poses a threat to TSM's market share.

investmentRisks.title: Regulatory Scrutiny from US
investmentRisks.description: TSM's dependence on the US market exposes it to regulatory changes and trade tensions.

investmentRisks.title: Valuation Concerns due to Memory Sales Decline
investmentRisks.description: Declining memory sales contribute to concerns about TSM's revenue growth and valuation.
